name: Drone Tyrant (Dread Archetype)
body:
There are few sights that chill the blood of mortal beings like the sudden darkening of the sky when a drone tyrant enters the battlefield. Commanding entire squadrons of fear-inducing mechs whose terrifying formations can spread horror across an entire battlefield, the drone tyrant can smother the hope in men’s hearts as surely as her mighty machines can fill the sky and block the sun’s light.

Diminished Manifesting

The drone tyrant’s training with her mech reduces her natural training and facility with psionic powers. The drone tyrant does not gain talents at 1st level, nor does she gain an additional power known at 2nd level and every three levels thereafter (5th, 8th, 11th, etc.).

This replaces the talents class feature and alters the drone tyrant’s powers known.

Bonded Mech (Ex)

The drone tyrant gains a bonded mech*, treating her class level as her pilot level.

Mech Swarm (Ex)

At 1st level, the drone tyrant gains Remote Piloting* as a bonus feat.

At 11th, 15th, and 19th level, the drone tyrant receives Remote Legion* as a bonus feat.

This replaces the fearsome insight and shadow twin class features.

Wings of Devastation (Su)

At 1st level, the drone tyrant may, as a standard action, command a mech under her control to make a melee touch attack against a living creature that deals 1d6 points of untyped damage plus 1 point per class level. If the drone tyrant spends a use of terror, this attack becomes a ranged touch attack with a range of 30 feet. The drone tyrant cannot use this ability through multiple bonded mechs with the same action.

This replaces the devastating touch class feature but counts as it for feats and effects.

Channeled Terror (Su)

From 2nd level on, whenever the drone tyrant gains a terror that is normally channeled through the dread’s devastating touch class feature, she may instead deliver it via his wings of devastation ability through any of his bonded mechs.

This alters, but in all other ways acts as, the dread’s terror class feature.

Spreading Eclipse (Su)

At 3rd level, the drone tyrant’s bonded mechs radiate an aura that causes all enemies within 10 feet to take a -4 penalty on saving throws against fear effects. Creatures that are normally immune to fear lose that immunity while adjacent to any of the drone tyrant’s bonded mechs. If two or more of the drone tyrant’s bonded mechs are within 10 feet of one another, the ambient light level in a 30- foot radius of each mech is lowered by one step.

This replaces but otherwise counts as the dread’s aura of fear.

Iron Nightmare (Su)

Starting at 11th level, whenever a bonded mech under the drone tyrant’s control is within 10 feet of a creature suffering from the shaken, frightened, or panicked conditions, the drone tyrant may use a free action to command it to take a single standard or move action. The drone tyrant may only take one such free action per bonded mech each round, and a bonded mech cannot take the action type twice in the same round as a result of this ability (for example, an drone tyrant could not have the same mech take two standard actions by spending a standard action to command it and then using this ability). Spells, powers, and other effects that would allow the mech to take additional actions still function normally.

This replaces the twin fear class feature.

Armor of Night (Ex)

At 20th level, the drone tyrant gains the ability to instantly recall all of her bonded mechs to her side, regardless of distance or location, as a full-round action (though the bonded mechs must have at least 1 hit point at the time this ability is activated). When using this ability, the mechs automatically form into a single mech around the drone tyrant as though the drone tyrant had a single bonded mech appropriate to his class level, and the drone tyrant is automatically considered to be piloting the new unified mech.

The mech formed in this way has full hit points for a creature of its Hit Dice, regardless of damage dealt to the component mechs when the ability was used. As long as the drone tyrant is piloting the unified mech, the aura of her spreading drone tyrant ability affects all creatures within 30 feet, and the ambient light level decreases by two steps in a 60-foot radius centered on the drone tyrant and her mech. The drone tyrant may dismiss this effect as a move action, causing the mechs to disassemble into their original individual bodies, splitting any remaining hit points possessed by the unified mech evenly between themselves and moving into the nearest unoccupied squares.

This replaces the fear incarnate class feature.
